name: Com7 Public Company Limited
summary: Com7 Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the retail business of information technology (IT) products in Thailand. It sells IT products, desktop computers, mobile phones, and accessories. The company also provides repair services for IT gadgets; financial services for mobiles, and other related services, as well as sells pet feeds.
